data_description: The input data consists of Dockerfile flakiness records, where builds may fail over time even though the content of the Dockerfile itself remains unchanged. Each record provides static information (Dockerfile context) and dynamic information (the pre-processed build output of the flaky Dockerfile).
use_case: Characterizing Dockerfile flakiness—unpredictable temporal build failures caused by external dependencies and evolving environments—by constructing a hierarchically structured taxonomy of flakiness. The taxonomy should organize observed flaky build outputs into main categories and associated subcategories that capture common flakiness causes.
